title: P2LRN IMS Content Package Profile
description: Preserves generic IMS/1EdTech Content Packaging archives that are not identified as SCORM, Common Cartridge or QTI, while projecting organizations and local resources into the P2LRN graph.
rules: Specialized SCORM, Common Cartridge and QTI packages MUST be identified by their specialized P2LRN profiles instead of this generic fallback profile.
The original IMS package SHOULD be preserved byte-for-byte when available.
imsmanifest.xml remains authoritative for source organization and resource metadata.
Organization/item ordering SHOULD be projected into P2LRN children ordering.
Local resource launch members MAY be delivered through the isolated generic package runtime when their media type is supported.
Unrecognized resource types MUST be preserved even when the Reader cannot execute them.
